title: FreePRM: Training Process Reward Models Without Ground Truth Process Labels
authors_zh: Lin Sun、Chuang Liu、Xiaofeng Ma、Tao Yang、Weijia Lu、Ning Wu（UAES AI Lab）
paper_type_zh: 弱监督过程标签构造与过程奖励模型训练研究
best_for_zh: 适合在只能廉价获得最终答案正确性时构建过程奖励监督的读者。
one_line: FreePRM learns step rewards from final-answer labels alone by adding a buffer state that absorbs uncertainty in trajectory-level pseudo supervision.
FreePRM 仅从最终答案标签学习步骤奖励，并用缓冲状态吸收轨迹级伪监督中的不确定性。
why: It turns the gap between outcome labels and step labels into an explicit uncertainty-aware training objective.
inclusion_reason: It replaces costly step labels with terminal-outcome pseudo labels and makes uncertainty buffering part of the process-reward training record.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Process reward models normally require a label for every reasoning step. Such labels are expensive to annotate and even automated rollout labels require many additional model calls. A final answer, however, is often cheap to check, but it does not reveal which intermediate step was sound or unsound.

FreePRM asks whether terminal outcome labels alone can train a useful step-level reward model. It begins with deliberately noisy pseudo labels that assign the outcome label to all steps, then changes the training objective so uncertain steps can avoid being forced into an unjustified correct-or-wrong decision.

过程奖励模型通常需要每个推理步骤都有标签。此类标签人工标注昂贵，即使自动轨迹展开标签也需要许多额外模型调用。然而，最终答案往往能被廉价检查，却不会告诉我们哪一个中间步骤正确或错误。

FreePRM 询问，只依赖终点结果标签能否训练出有用的步骤级奖励模型。它先用有意带噪的伪标签将结果标签赋给所有步骤，再改变训练目标，使不确定步骤不必被强迫做出没有依据的正确或错误判断。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The key distinction is a third buffer probability between wrong and right. A correct final answer makes every step tentatively positive and an incorrect final answer makes every step tentatively negative, but the buffer absorbs probability mass when that inherited label is ambiguous or likely wrong.

The model does not simply add a neutral class. A random buffer factor prevents the trivial solution in which every step becomes entirely uncertain, and the final step receives a larger loss weight because it has the strongest connection to the terminal outcome. Thus the record carries terminal supervision, local uncertainty, and step position together.

关键区别在于错误和正确之间的第三种缓冲概率。最终答案正确会使每一步暂时被标为正，最终答案错误会使每一步暂时被标为负，但当继承来的标签含糊或可能错误时，缓冲状态会吸收概率质量。

模型并非只是加入中立类别。随机缓冲因子防止每个步骤都变成完全不确定这一平凡解，而最终步骤因与终点结果联系最强获得更大的损失权重。因此，记录将终点监督、局部不确定性和步骤位置共同保存。

title: Method
方法
html:
The authors take Math-Shepherd problems and answers but discard its process labels. Each trajectory is divided by a special delimiter; its terminal answer supplies one binary pseudo label for all steps. Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct predicts wrong, buffer, and right probabilities, while a sampled Bernoulli buffer factor determines whether the buffer can soften the pseudo-label loss at that step.

The final step is upweighted and has no buffer contribution. Training uses batch size 16, learning rate 1e-4, and two A40 GPUs. For best-of-N evaluation, candidate reasoning traces are step-scored and the last step score ranks whole responses; the paper uses up to 128 candidates on MATH-500.

作者使用 Math-Shepherd 的问题和答案，但丢弃其过程标签。每条轨迹由特殊分隔符切分；其终点答案为所有步骤提供一个二元伪标签。Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct 预测错误、缓冲和正确概率，而采样的伯努利缓冲因子决定缓冲是否能在该步骤软化伪标签损失。

最终步骤被加权且不含缓冲贡献。训练使用批大小 16、学习率 1e-4 和两张 A40 GPU。对于最佳 N 选一评测，候选推理轨迹按步骤评分，最后一步分数排列完整回答；论文在 MATH-500 上使用最多 128 个候选。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
On ProcessBench, FreePRM reports an average F1 of 53.0. This exceeds the Qwen2.5 model trained on Math-Shepherd labels at 28.9, Skywork-PRM-7B at 42.1, and EurusPRM-Stage2 at 31.3; it remains below the manually labeled PRM800K model at 56.5. The comparison is important because FreePRM excludes process labels during training.

The paper also reports best-of-N gains across four policy generators and states that it matches or exceeds PRMs trained on automatically labeled process data. Ablations attribute improvement to both the random buffer factor and stronger final-step supervision; with all components, the reported ProcessBench average is 49.1 in that ablation setting.

在 ProcessBench 上，FreePRM 报告平均 F1 为 53.0。这超过了使用 Math-Shepherd 标签训练的 Qwen2.5 模型的 28.9、Skywork-PRM-7B 的 42.1 和 EurusPRM-Stage2 的 31.3；但仍低于人工标注 PRM800K 模型的 56.5。这个比较很重要，因为 FreePRM 在训练中排除了过程标签。

论文还报告其在四个策略生成器上的最佳 N 选一提升，并称它能匹配或超过使用自动过程标签训练的过程奖励模型。消融将改进归因于随机缓冲因子和更强的最终步骤监督；在该消融设置中，所有组件齐全时报告的 ProcessBench 平均值为 49.1。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier weak process supervision commonly estimates each intermediate state's probability of reaching a correct answer through expensive continuations. FreePRM accepts a much weaker and noisier label source, then changes the classifier's output space and loss so the training record can represent uncertainty rather than pretending outcome correctness is a faithful step annotation.

Its distinctive contribution is the coupling of pseudo-label lineage with buffer probability and final-step weighting. This is a data-consumption change: the same terminal label affects different steps differently, and the model learns when not to trust its inherited label. The novelty lies in that uncertainty-aware objective, not in a new answer verifier.

较早的弱过程监督通常通过昂贵的后续轨迹估计每个中间状态到达正确答案的概率。FreePRM 接受更弱且噪声更大的标签来源，然后改变分类器的输出空间和损失，使训练记录能够表示不确定性，而不是假装结果正确性是忠实的步骤标注。

它独特的贡献是将伪标签来源、缓冲概率和最终步骤加权耦合起来。这是一种数据消费改变：同一个终点标签对不同步骤产生不同影响，模型学习何时不应相信继承来的标签。新意在于这个不确定性感知目标，而不在于新的答案验证器。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Final outcome correctness remains an imperfect proxy: a correct answer can contain flawed reasoning and an incorrect answer can begin with valid steps. The paper relies on stronger supervision for the final step and uses that score to rank whole solutions, which can conceal earlier defects. Evidence is mathematical and the work remains under review, so the reported result needs independent replication on domains with different error structure.
最终结果正确性仍是不完美的代理：正确答案可以包含有缺陷的推理，错误答案也可以从有效步骤开始。论文依赖对最终步骤更强的监督，并使用该分数排列完整解答，这可能掩盖较早的缺陷。证据限于数学且工作仍在审稿中，因此报告的结果需要在具有不同错误结构的领域中独立复现。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this card when final answers can be checked cheaply but process labels cannot be purchased or generated at rollout scale. Preserve the terminal checker, pseudo-label rule, buffer probability, random factor, and final-step weight as first-class metadata. They define the actual supervision contract and make it possible to compare a buffer-aware weak-label PRM with a conventional binary one.
当最终答案能被廉价检查、但过程标签无法购买或无法以轨迹展开规模生成时，可使用这张卡。应将终点检查器、伪标签规则、缓冲概率、随机因子和最终步骤权重保留为一级元数据。它们定义真实的监督契约，并使缓冲感知弱标签过程奖励模型能与传统二元模型比较。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read FreePRM as a controlled compromise between no process information and expensive process labels. Check the outcome verifier, inspect whether a buffer prediction aligns with actual ambiguous steps, and evaluate first-error detection rather than only best-of-N accuracy. A downstream team should also test whether using the last-step reward, rather than a minimum or aggregate score, changes what kinds of erroneous traces are selected.
应将 FreePRM 作为无过程信息与昂贵过程标签之间受控折中的方案阅读。检查结果验证器，观察缓冲预测是否与真实含糊步骤一致，并评估最早错误检测而不只看最佳 N 选一准确率。下游团队还应测试使用最后一步奖励而非最小或聚合分数，是否会改变被选中的错误轨迹类型。
